finalText:
Build is clean now. The real error was buried at line 17 of `src/core/settings.js` — it was referencing an undefined `retries` variable instead of `env.retries`. Changed it to `env.retries || 2` to pull the retry count from the passed environment with a sensible default.

The three warnings stay (deprecated API, unused export, circular import), but those are safe to ignore for now. Build exits with 0 errors.
